subject: The 2AM setup our top users swear by
preview_text: How 1% of Bass Booster users get bass that actually shakes your phone. One trick changes everything.
body_paragraphs: You know that moment when a track drops, and you just feel it in your chest? Most people never get that from their phone. But the top 1% of our users do it every day. And they don't use some secret app—they just set up their workflow differently.

Here's what they figured out: the default profile is for casual listening. But when you want the bass to hit like a subwoofer, you need to switch to the custom EQ and push the low end to +6dB. Then turn on the Bass Virtualizer. That's it. Two taps, and your phone sounds like a club speaker.

They're not power users. They're just people who took 30 seconds to tweak the 10-band EQ and save it as a custom profile. Now every song—whether it's Drake, Skrillex, or Led Zeppelin—hits harder. You've already got this feature in the app. It's sitting there, waiting for you to unlock the full experience.

Open Bass Booster now. Go to the EQ tab, drag the 60Hz slider to +6dB, and turn on Bass Virtualizer. Hit save. Then play your favorite track. Feel the difference? That's what you've been missing. P.S. Premium users get unlimited boost on top of that—our top 1% say it's the only way to make earbuds actually thump.
cta_text: Open Bass Booster and tweak your EQ
